title: Cosmic Dragon Vision
description: A surreal circular composition shows a woman with flowing red-orange hair looking upward, her face adorned with glowing markings. Inside the transparent sphere are a futuristic city skyline at dusk, a multi-lane highway with moving cars, and a luminous orange and pink serpentine dragon coiled on the right, surrounded by floating red leaves, lightning, and two glowing orbs in a vibrant sky.
prompt: A woman with flowing fiery orange and red hair looking up in wonder, inside a transparent glowing sphere containing a futuristic city skyline at sunset, a busy highway with cars, and a luminous serpentine Eastern dragon made of orange and pink energy. Lightning cracks across the sphere, two glowing celestial orbs hang in a green and pink sky, red maple leaves float around, vibrant neon colors, intricate details, surreal fantasy scene.
